Maya (AE): Heads-up team 10: Falconcrest wants an exec sync to unblock the POC. Their asks: BYO-KMS with proof of no-key-access, a POC SLA P95 99.9% latency target, and a short-term commercial concession for the trial. Can we assemble folks for a bridge tomorrow 9am PST?
Liam (SE): I can cover the demo + latency validation. Note: our KV cache persistency isn't persisted across restarts; they asked for "persisted KV cache" as a hard requirement. We should surface that.
Eli (Security): For BYO-KMS we have an attestation template stating Redwood does not store customer key material. We can provide rotation cadence and access controls in writing, but not attest to customer's KMS ops.
Tess (Legal): If they require a contractual guarantee around key custody we need an addendum. Draft language: "Customer retains sole control of keying material; Redwood will not access or derive customer keys." I'll prepare a redline.
Maya (AE): Copied their DM: "We need: 1) BYO-KMS with unilateral customer control and technical attestation, 2) P95 under 120ms during POC, 3) 25% POC credit up to $20k."
Carmen (VP Sales): 25% up front is reasonable if they're committing to pilot-to-prod conversion. What's the expected ARR if they convert?
Maya (AE): Pilot -> Dedicated multi-region expected ARR ~ $900k.
Nora (CRO): Given ARR, we can offer a one-time POC concession. I need: exact cap, duration, and an internal approval path. Who will take finance sign-off?
Carmen (VP Sales): I'll loop Finance. Also want a clear rollback if POC doesn't convert. No open-ended discounts.
Liam (SE): Technical note: to prove P95 we should pre-run a load profile and capture traces. Raj, can you help with the load harness and save traces for the bridge demo?
Raj (Eng): Yes. I can run a 30-minute load and produce a P95 report. No infra changes needed.
Eli (Security): I'll upload the attestation to our internal docs and highlight the clauses that map to their asks. We should be explicit that Redwood does not have decryption capabilities for customer-managed keys.
Tess (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and include the clause prohibiting Redwood access and specifying indemnities. Need to know if they expect HSM-backed proofs; that affects language.
Maya (AE): I'll ask them if HSM attestation is required. Proposed bridge time: tomorrow 9am PST. Internal attendees: Maya, Nora, Carmen, Liam, Eli, Tess, Raj.
calendar-bot: /create-bridge Falconcrest-exec-bridge Tue 2025-10-14 09:00 PST 1 Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.internal/bridges/fc-bridge-2912345678
Nora (CRO): I'll attend and frame the concession. Carmen, please loop Finance and return with pre-approval or a quick decision window.
Carmen (VP Sales): On it. I'll ask for a 4-hour turnaround.
Liam (SE): I'll add the KV-cache caveat to the demo script. If they insist on persisted cache across restarts, that's a roadmap item and may delay production.
Maya (AE): Action items: Tess to send addendum draft by EOD; Eli to publish attestation link; Raj to run load and share P95 traces; Carmen to secure finance pre-approval for $20k cap; Liam/Raj to prep demo script.
Tess (Legal): Will share draft by 5pm PT.
Eli (Security): Uploading attestation now: https://internal.redwood/docs/byo-kms-attestation-2025.pdf
Raj (Eng): Scheduling load run at 3pm PT today. Will post results.
Maya (AE): I'll draft the customer invite once legal text & finance cap are confirmed. Please flag any blockers. :thumbsup:
Nora (CRO): Quick clarification: the SLA ask is for the POC window only; we should propose a measured SLA with explicit metrics (P95 latency target verified by our traces) rather than a blanket 99.9% guarantee. That keeps risk manageable.
Carmen (VP Sales): Agreed. We'll phrase it as "targeted P95 objective for POC demonstration" with acceptance criteria. Finance, please confirm the $20k cap by 1pm PST.
Maya (AE): Closing loop 1 sending internal invite in 15m for folks joining the bridge prep.
